curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Johnny Madrid stay on the run after narrowly escaping death with Esmeralda at his side?
curatedMovie.description: A century ago, outlaw Johnny Madrid narrowly escapes death and goes on the run with Esmeralda, the hangman’s sensuous daughter.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-moving and suspenseful Western horror that delivers high-energy danger without demanding heavy emotional investment.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director P.J. Pesce merges the dusty tropes of a classic Western with rapid-fire horror-thriller tension, delivering a kinetic outlaw pursuit packed into a lean 94 minutes.

facts.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
